defs: Decoding
Finding the most probable hidden state sequence for observations.
Viterbi algorithm
Dynamic programming for the best path: max over predecessors per cell.
Backpointer
The argmax predecessor stored for each cell.
Lattice / trellis
Grid of states × time filled by Viterbi.
Forward algorithm
Viterbi with sum instead of max: total observation probability.
Beam search
Keep only the top k states per column (approximate).
MEMM
Maximum Entropy Markov Model: per-position logistic regression P(tᵢ | wᵢ, tᵢ₋₁, features).
Greedy decoding
Lock in the best tag at each word left to right.
Label bias
Local normalisation lets states ignore observations.
CRF
Conditional random field: globally normalised sequence model.
takeaways: Viterbi beats greedy; CRFs fix label bias.
confused: Exact best sequence vs locally best choices.
recall.minute: Decoding = argmax over tag sequences of Π P(tᵢ|tᵢ₋₁)P(wᵢ|tᵢ); brute force Nⁿ (45¹⁰ ≈ 3.4 × 10¹⁶). Viterbi: v₁(j) = πⱼbⱼ(o₁); vₜ(j) = maxᵢ vₜ₋₁(i)aᵢⱼbⱼ(oₜ) with backpointers; backtrace from the best final cell. One cell: 0.03 × 0.2 = 0.006 vs 0.0015 × 0.3 = 0.00045 → Verb, V = 0.006. 'the doctor is in': Det 0.21; doctor Noun 0.0756 / Verb 0.00021; is Verb 0.027216 / Noun 0.001512; in Prep 0.005443 / Adv 0.000272 → Det Noun Verb Prep. Weather (π 0.8/0.2; 3, 1): 0.32/0.02 → H 0.0384, C 0.064 → H C. O(N²T). HMM limits: unknown words, limited context, no rich features, sparsity, left-to-right only (bidirectional passes). MEMM: logistic regression P(tᵢ | wᵢ, tᵢ₋₁) with features (prev MD, ends -ck, lowercase); 2.0/0.5 → 0.82/0.18. Decode with Viterbi, not greedy (old man the boats: 0.30 vs 0.40). Label bias from local normalisation; CRFs normalise globally.
